recognize_zh: 免疫組織化學染色中，一個圓形區域（生發中心）幾乎不染，周圍一圈小淋巴球則呈棕色膜狀陽性，形成「中空甜甜圈」樣式，符合正常反應性濾泡中外套區陽性、生發中心陰性的抗原表現。
features: Round central zone of largely unstained cells (germinal center)
Surrounding cells with brown membranous/cytoplasmic staining forming a ring (mantle zone) and extending into interfollicular areas
Only rare positive cells within the negative central zone
Specific antigen not identified in the image
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of lymphoid tissue at low-to-medium power shows a round, largely negative germinal center surrounded by positively stained small lymphocytes of the mantle and interfollicular zones, with only rare positive cells within the center. The antigen is not specified; this reciprocal pattern is typical of markers such as BCL2 or IgD in a normal reactive follicle. Findings are consistent with a normal secondary follicle with a negative germinal center.

ddx.vs: In FL, neoplastic follicle centers are BCL2 positive, whereas here the germinal center is negative with positivity confined to the surrounding cells.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: MCL expands the mantle with cyclin D1/SOX11-positive cells, which cannot be distinguished from normal mantle cells on this stain without the specific antigen.
